references.text: Samson revealed that his strength was tied to his hair, which had never been cut, explaining the significance of his hair now beginning to grow back.
Here Samson's hair was shaved off, causing him to lose his strength. Verse 22 shows that the hair began to grow again.
The Nazirite vow forbade cutting one's hair, which was central to Samson's strength and calling from birth.
Samson's strength returned after his hair had grown out, enabling him to carry out his final act against the Philistines.
The angel announced that Samson would be a Nazirite from birth, and that no razor should touch his head.
